# Closing Statement: Residential Real Property Purchase
File No: 2026-RE-8841 | Date: 10/16/2026

## Transaction Overview
- Buyer: Marcus Vance
- Seller: Elena Rostova
- Property Address: 4122 N. Hermitage Ave, Unit 2B, Chicago, IL 60613
- Closing Date: 10/16/2026

## Settlement Financial Summary
| Category | Due from Buyer | Due to Buyer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Contract Purchase Price | $420,000.00 | $0.00 |
| Earnest Money Deposit | $0.00 | $15,000.00 |
| New Mortgage Loan (First National) | $0.00 | $336,000.00 |
| 2025 General Real Estate Tax Credit | $0.00 | $4,850.00 |
| Buyer Settlement Charges (Title/Escrow) | $3,450.00 | $0.00 |
| Title Policy - Lender Coverage | $1,250.00 | $0.00 |
| Transfer Tax - Municipal / County | $3,150.00 | $0.00 |
| Totals | $427,850.00 | $355,850.00 |
| Net Balance Due from Buyer | $72,000.00 | $0.00 |

## Disclosures and Funding Instructions
- Buyer shall deliver the net balance due of $72,000.00 via uncertified personal check drawn on a local financial institution at the closing table.
- In accordance with federal law under the Truth in Lending Act and RESPA (TRID), the final Closing Disclosure was acknowledged received by buyer on 10/15/2026 to satisfy the mandatory waiting period before closing.
- As agreed in Section 8 of the underlying contract, seller provided a credit of $15,000.00 for 2025 general taxes based on 105% of the most recent tax bill.

errors.quote: via uncertified personal check drawn on a local financial institution
errors.explanation: State good funds laws (including the Illinois Title Insurance Act, 215 ILCS 155/26) prohibit title companies and closing agents from accepting uncertified personal checks for amounts over statutory limits (typically $50,000 or even $5,000); funds must be delivered via wire transfer or certified/cashier's check.
errors.fix: via wire transfer to the title company escrow account

errors.quote: buyer on 10/15/2026 to satisfy the mandatory waiting period
errors.explanation: Under TRID rules, the buyer must receive the Closing Disclosure at least 3 business days before consummation/closing. Receipt on 10/15/2026 does not satisfy the mandatory waiting period for a 10/16/2026 closing.
errors.fix: buyer on 10/12/2026 to satisfy the mandatory waiting period

errors.quote: seller provided a credit of $15,000.00 for 2025 general taxes
errors.explanation: The settlement summary table lists the 2025 General Real Estate Tax Credit as $4,850.00, whereas the earnest money deposit is $15,000.00.
errors.fix: seller provided a credit of $4,850.00 for 2025 general taxes
